positions.title: Robotics Project Lead/Lead Programmer/Robotics Researcher
positions.description:
Research and develop programs to enable machines known as arduinos to perform certain functions such as line tracking, mimicry, movement, and flight.
Developed code that would enable a robot known as an Arduino to track lines without the use of an operator.
Calibrated accelerometer to be used for quad-copter robot 
Developed continuous self activation code that would check processes and startup those processes and check to ensure the process stays continuously active
Lead the design, construction, and programming of a project known as the Emergency 
Response Bot. A robot designed to be used in schools for emergency situations such as 
small fires and shootings.

positions.title: 2D Artist/Programmer
positions.description:
Developing and helping others develop games in the community for any platform
Lead in the design, programming, and art of a web game known as Immune System, a 
top-down 2D shooter
Designed 2D sprites and textures 
Programmed movement, AI, and animation scripts

projects.title: Immune System
projects.description: A top-down shooter. The goal: As a white blood cell your job is to protect the heart from diseases and other ailments. But be careful if you or the heart take too much damage you'll flatline in no time.

projects.title: Avionica Onboard Network System (avONS)(2019- 2021)
projects.description: The avONS is capable of hosting a variety of self-created software applications as well is capable of providing cellular and wifi connectivity aboard aircraft. Tasks included the implementation of the discrete reads required to allow the wifi portion to function when an aircraft is on the ground, generating separate apps to run on the platform using Docker, creation of library  to sync configurations between ground systems and on-aircraft units,  DO-178C certification effort of the wifi component. Python
